grh_3e3c08801918f03c797a.title: Blackmail Is a Nasty Word
paragraphs: Harry becomes vulnerable to a counterfeiting charge when young Heidi threatens to swear that she saw him pass bogus money unless he helps bring her father out from behind the Iron Curtain. With help from fixer Mama Regent, Harry works on the escape while stumbling into the secret of French politician Givolle. Givolle had collaborated with the Nazis under a false identity and later rebuilt a respectable political career; gangsters had already used that secret for protection. Harry unknowingly frightens him with what sounds like another blackmail threat, and Givolle eventually kills himself. Harry later meets Heidi safely reunited with her father and agrees never to use that particular nasty word again.
